| eval HourOfDay=strftime(_time, "%H")

| where api_calls > expected_upper_threshold
| eval distance_from_threshold = api_calls - expected_upper_threshold
| table _time, user, command, api_calls, expected_upper_threshold, distance_from_threshold
| `abnormally_high_number_of_cloud_infrastructure_api_calls_filter`

title: Linux PAM Module Modified Outside Package Management
id: 7a4f2b21-9c0a-4d62-8e57-1b3f0c41ce11
description: Detects creation or modification of pam_unix.so or other pam_*.so modules in standard PAM library paths by processes other than known package managers. Aligns with Velvet Ant 'Operation Highland' PAM backdoor TTP.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/chinese-hackers-hijack-auth-flow-spy-on-isolated-network-for-a-decade/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/13
tags:
  - attack.t1556.003
  - attack.t1554
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.credential_access
logsource:
  product: linux
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|startswith:
      - '/lib/security/pam_'
      - '/lib64/security/pam_'
      - '/usr/lib/security/pam_'
      - '/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/security/pam_'
      - '/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/security/pam_'
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.so'
  filter_pkgmgr:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/dpkg'
      - '/rpm'
      - '/yum'
      - '/dnf'
      - '/apt'
      - '/apt-get'
      - '/zypper'
      - '/pacman'
      - '/unattended-upgrade'

level: high
